S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.

subtypes.Chronic Worry: Worry occurs more days than not for at least 6 months.
subtypes.Generalized Worry: Worry is not confined to specific topics but spreads to various domains like work, school, family, and finances.
subtypes.Catastrophizing: Jumping to conclusions that minor mistakes or events will lead to irreversible disasters.
subtypes.Intolerance of Uncertainty: Unable to tolerate future uncertainty, trapped in 'what if' questions.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.

subtypes.Failure to Control: Unable to regulate worry despite efforts to stop or distract oneself.
subtypes.Intrusive Worry: Worries suddenly intrude into the mind and interfere with focus while doing other tasks.
subtypes.Chaining of Worry: One worry triggers another in a chain reaction, escalating to catastrophic thoughts.

S058.name: Restlessness_Tension
S058.description: Restlessness, or feeling keyed up or on edge.

subtypes.Feeling Keyed Up: Feeling anxious and wound up like a spring, unable to stay still.
subtypes.Physical Tension: The entire body feels stiff and tense, unable to relax.
subtypes.Nervousness: Nerves are on edge, being startled easily by minor sounds or stimuli.

S060.name: Irritability
S060.description: A state of reacting sensitively or sharply to minor stimuli.

subtypes.Low Frustration Tolerance: Getting annoyed immediately at trivial stimuli that would normally be ignored.
subtypes.Snappiness: Nerves are sharp, leading to sensitive and aggressive reactions to small matters.
subtypes.Exhausted Patience: Patience is depleted, making it impossible to endure minor inconveniences or delays.

symptom.disease_info: Generalized Anxiety Disorder is characterized by persistent, excessive worry about multiple areas of life that is difficult to control and lasts for months, accompanied by tension, sleep disturbance, irritability, or related symptoms. It typically develops gradually and becomes clinically significant when worry spreads beyond the original stressor and begins impairing work, relationships, or daily routines. It is distinguished from phobic, panic, or trauma-related anxiety by its broad, sustained, anticipatory worry rather than fear tied to one specific object, attack, or traumatic reminder.

patient.stressor_event: Major change in the health or behavior of a family member
patient.stressor: About thirteen months before she was seen, Daniela’s older sister in Arecibo began needing substantially more family help, shifting Daniela into a coordinating role for appointments, transportation, household tasks, and communication among relatives while she was still managing municipal IT responsibilities. Her early concern fit her practical, family-centered values, but gradually the worry generalized to work system failures, her husband’s safety, church obligations, finances, and whether she was disappointing people who depended on her. She continued functioning, yet sleep became less restorative, she felt keyed up much of the day, and her uncharacteristic irritability began showing in documentation meetings, choir practice, and Sunday family cooking. During a routine primary-care visit, she described the year-long pattern and its effect on work and family life, and her physician referred her to a psychiatrist.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.
S027.manifestation: Most nights I do fall asleep eventually, but I wake up around three or four thinking about my sister’s next appointment or some server issue at work, and even when I get enough hours I start the morning feeling like I never really rested.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.
S056.manifestation: My mind keeps going from one concern to another—my sister in Arecibo, whether I missed something at the office, my husband driving home, church commitments, bills—and I find myself preparing for problems that haven’t even happened.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.
S057.manifestation: I’ll tell myself, ‘Daniela, enough, focus on this report,’ but one small thought turns into five more, and before I know it I’ve spent half an hour checking messages or replaying what could go wrong.

S058.name: Restlessness_Tension
S058.description: Restlessness, or feeling keyed up or on edge.
S058.manifestation: I came in because I feel wound up almost all day, like my body is bracing for something, even when I’m just sitting at my computer or trying to relax after dinner.

S060.name: Irritability
S060.description: A state of reacting sensitively or sharply to minor stimuli.
S060.manifestation: I’m usually patient, but lately little things like a late update in a documentation meeting, someone singing off-tempo at choir, or too many questions while I’m cooking on Sunday make me answer sharper than I mean to.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: I’m still getting my work done and showing up for family and church, but it takes me longer to finish reports, I double-check things more than I used to, and I’ve had to apologize for sounding short with people I care about.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on for about thirteen months, since my sister in Arecibo started needing much more help from the family.
